title: Logo-only Joomla headers derive safe navigation hides from planned page identities
steps: Run the pure navigation fallback and existing header, WordPress and runtime Home guard tests. No provider or running site is needed.
expect: A header with no label slots identifies the unique menu and exports unplanned kit-mapped hides without writer labels.
Ambiguous or conflicting identities yield no hides; other menus and administrator items remain untouched.
Kept descendants preserve their ancestors, and unrepresented roots and descendants remain published.
Existing header votes take priority and the runtime door refuses to unpublish default Home.

tests: a logo-only header derives navigation and hides unplanned pages without inventing writer slots
duplicate path evidence in two menus cannot identify a main menu
other menus, unknown roots and unmapped descendants stay untouched
a kept descendant preserves its navigation ancestors even without a kept top-level label
a duplicate path within the inferred menu refuses the fallback
runtime default Home cannot be unpublished even when planned by a stale map
the mapping export keeps hide authority without claiming any writer labels
conflicting planned menu types refuse all hides
administrator menu items are excluded from the fallback tree
existing header votes take priority over plan path inference
